text:
Hi everyone,
Hope you are all doing amazing. 

I’m currently on a B/1 visa as part of the partner visa process (Israeli wife), and I will start a full-time job as an employee in an Israeli startup.

I have some questions regarding tax purposes:

* How are B/1 visa holders in this situation usually registered for payroll?

* Are we eligible for tax credit points (nekudot zikui) or treated as non-residents?

* Are we considered a tax resident or non-resident during the B/1 stage?

* Is there anything specific I should ask HR before signing my employment contract?

I would really appreciate hearing from any personal experience who has gone through a similar situation. 

Thank you!
